title: Exclusion of Infinite Spin for N-body problem in $\mathbb{R}^d$
summary: We show that there is no infinite spin at total collisions for $-κ$-homogeneous N-body problem in higher dimensional Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^d$, in which $0 < κ< 2$ ($κ= 1$ the Newtonian case), provided the limiting normalized central configuration is isolated and is of dimension d or d - 1. In the Newtonian case $κ= 1$, this extends the work of Moeckel-Montgomery to $d \ge 3$ and in the d = 3 case offers a different approach as compared to the current preprint of Pinzari-Zgliczynski.
